hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh|*.bash) if ! out=$(bash -n "$f" 2>&1); then jq -nc --arg msg "bash -n syntax error: $out" '{systemMessage: $msg, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $msg}}'; fi;; esac; }
